instruction: Treat two complete DOLFINx 0.10 linear-elasticity jobs, /home/user/Desktop/job_a.py and /home/user/Desktop/job_b.py as the starting point. Before starting the work, the DOLFINx package is installed under `/usr/lib/petsc/lib/python3/dist-packages/dolfinx`; run this workflow from Python with that module available. Both model the same 100 mm x 10 mm x 10 mm steel cantilever with E = 210000 MPa and nu = 0.3; job_a applies -100 N total Y force to the free end and job_b applies -200 N. Work only from the command line. Create /home/user/Desktop/run_pipeline.py to run job_a.py and job_b.py serially and fail unless each creates its .xdmf and _metrics.json files. Create /home/user/Desktop/compare.py to read the two metric files, verify the XDMF files exist, compute job_b/job_a ratios for maximum von Mises stress and free-end UY, and write /home/user/Desktop/comparison_report.txt with exactly these four CSV rows: job_a,max_mises,tip_uy; job_b,max_mises,tip_uy; Ratio_Mises,value; Ratio_Displacement,value. Run the pipeline and comparison scripts. Do not use a GUI.
